intro
Welcome to the Follow-up Program sign-up. Here is how to book your sessions, in about a minute.
s1
Open the link. Type your name and mobile number once. The page remembers them.
s2
The calendar shows this week. Each day says how many sessions are open. Use the arrows for other weeks, or tap a day to jump to its sessions.
s3
Tap Select on the sessions you can take. To come every week, choose Same session, next four dates, in the bar at the bottom.
s4
Booking for others too? Tap Who, under your mobile number. Tick speakers from the list, or type a name and mobile.
s5
Tap Register. Check the list of dates and names, then tap Confirm. Your dates now show under My registrations.
s6
Can't come one day? Tap Release on that date. Your other dates stay booked. Release closes twelve hours before the start; after that, please call the organiser.
s7
If the organisers cancel a date, a red notice appears at the top. Please don't go that day.
s8
Prefer Telugu or Hindi? Just choose your language at the top.
end
That's it. Open the link, select your sessions, and tap Register.
